answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round.
